name: Never Safe in Delaware
storyline: In the aftermath of a country-wide civil war, Delaware has been transformed into a prison state. Criminals from every neighboring power are sent there, ruled by a heavily militarized city-state government. Declared one of the worst cities in the Western Hemisphere, Delaware becomes the battleground for three lowlifes: a vagabond, a rat, and a pastor, who are pulled into a deadly conspiracy. Against all odds, they become America’s most unlikely heroes as they fight to escape the prison city.
summary:
Never Safe in Delaware is built on a kinetic combat system inspired by games such as Max Payne, Hotline Miami, and Brutal Doom. We've taken notes from the best games in the action genre to achieve precise gunplay and satisfying melee combat.

Take control of three of America’s most dangerous fugitives in a breakneck, intense battle against the scum and criminals infesting the city.
